description: List the replies under one discussion entry, oldest first. Read-only. Bodies are fenced as untrusted text. To read a whole thread at once, use get_full_topic_view instead.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: list_entry_replies
title: List Entry Replies
